lines.en: The sky is blue and things are good! Everything is fine.
The sky is orange, things are meh. A gradual decline.
The sky is dark, now things are bad. I wonder what comes next?
An unexpected thunderstorm. It’s poetry at best.
I’ve never liked tercets. They always leave me feeling 75%% complete.
Sekai was like that too, which is why she taught me to write in fours.
It’s something I’ve carried with me throughout most of my life, even if it was shoved so far down in the depths of my pocket until recently that I forgot it was there.
It’s all shriveled and crumpled up now — like an old note with repeating initials scribbled along the bottom of it. But I can still make it out if I squint.
It’s just a bunch of lines, really. M is such a strange letter. But that comes in fours too. So maybe there’s something poetic about its existence I’m not quite comprehending?
And maybe if I hold this metaphorical note up to the sky, the rain will erase the text and I will never have to remember losing something I never wanted to begin with.
There’s something to say about a stray cat here. I just don’t really want to — nor do I have the energy to reach back into my pocket at this point in time.
But maybe, if that one has been run over by a car or eaten by a larger animal, I can find it within me to search for a new one.
I hear the shelters are packed this time of year.
: Well, well, well! Look who finally decided to show up.
: Is it raining out there? You’re wetter than Osako after I break out the handcuffs.
: It is, in fact, raining out there. And I’m not the type to use an umbrella.
: Is that because you’re stupid? Or do you just think saying things like that makes you somehow sound cooler?
: Don’t talk to me about trying to be cool when you’re over there just...being hot and...leaning up against a pool table.
: Need I remind you of my condition, Arakawa? Leaning up against things is something I must do for my health. Being cool is merely a side effect of that, I suppose.
: I’d also appreciate it if you wouldn’t so directly proclaim your attraction to me in public as it makes me nauseous. Please die.
: Can I at least get a beer first?
: No. Because now I want to die. Your aura is already suffocating, the last thing I need is you wandering in like a wet dog who-
: Can you guys just fuck already if that’ll put an end to this bickering?
: Yes.
: No.
: Damn it.
: You want me to see if I can go grab a towel from the bartender or are you too cool for those too?
: I’m too cool for those too. Let’s just get down to business. I know why you called me here.
: I’d sure hope you know why I called you here considering we’ve had this meeting planned for an entire week. You still down?
: To be once again treated as a piece of meat held over an open flame surrounded by twenty hungry high schoolers? You know it.
: I don’t know whether I should be impressed by your fearless march to death or mourn the loss of whatever respect I may have once had for you.
: There’s nothing impressive about what I’m doing. I’m just the carrot on a stick Imani needs to cultivate camaraderie among the class I abandoned and left to her.
: Like it or not, the consensus shows that Dorm Wars just wasn’t the same without you last year. So thanks for volunteering to come back for a day.
: And just...one day. Correct? You haven’t been bribed into attending a second or anything like that?
: No. I have not been bribed into attending a second day.
That is a decision I willingly made without bribery. But I have promised to conceal it from Imani, so it will remain unsaid for now.
: I’ll say, Arakawa — as happy as I may look to have you coming back to school, I do wish it’d be for a bit longer than just a day.
: You don’t look happy at all. Why don’t your expressions ever match your dialogue?
: That’s rich coming from you, Senpai. You wear the same expression even when you’re boning me. And, not gonna lie, it makes me pretty self-conscious.
: Osako has said the same thing about me. But being self-conscious is her default state, so I’ve learned to just expect and accept it.
: Either way, there’s no need to thank me. This just gives me an excuse to be around all of the girls at once again.
: And it remains to be seen whether or not this will mentally impact me as much as it did at the Christmas party. Let’s hope not.
: Best Christmas ever as far as I’m concerned.
: Yes, nothing says “holiday cheer” like bending over for your superior. I’m glad to see you were paying attention at the last HR seminar.
: They don’t even send me emails anymore. I think I’m either exempt or just fired and I haven’t heard about it yet.
: I swear, it’s like your class exists in its own bubble not governed by the rules of society nor those which govern the school. I can’t help but be envious.
: Wanna trade places for a day then? You teach my class, I teach yours?
: I’m no longer envious at all and am back to wanting to die.
: Yeah. That’s what I thought.
: So I just...show up then? Where? What time?
: We’ll be all over the school that day and you can show up whenever you want. But you’re not technically needed until the third contest of the day.
: Which is what exactly?
: A battle between Maya and Otoha to see who can be the nicest to you.
: Oh, okay. So you’re just trying to ruin my day from the very beginning then.
: Is that not my job as your lovable kouhai and best friend?
: I don’t think so, no.
: Could be worse, Arakawa. I could be competing as well.
: Sure, but at least I know that when you’re being mean to me, it’s because that’s the only way you know to express yourself.
: Or you have deluded yourself into thinking I care about you as you’re far too dense to accept that there are people out there who genuinely despise your existence.
: Everyone wants a piece of this and you’re a part of everyone, Wakana.
: I’d rather be a part of a group of criminals sent to death via firing squad.
: Guys, seriously. I can deal with the emotional repercussions of you doing the sexy tango if it allows us to have a civilized discussion for once.
: You heard the woman. Let’s go.
: Sorry, Imani. I do attend the HR seminars.
: They still make you go to those?
: Oh, Osako. I didn’t realize you walked in.
: Yeah, sorry. I got held up by the rain on the way back from the cafe.
: And I assume Akira did too based on the fact that he is soaking wet from probably being too cool to use an umbrella.
: Imani is trying to ruin my weekend and your girlfriend won’t have sex with me. Please fix this.
: No.
: Why am I so universally hated?
: Anyway! I guess we can file the Dorm Wars preamble into the “completed” category and go meet back up with Rika at the counter since she’s been alone this whole time.
: I’m sure she’s fine. I put on Dog TV for her on my phone before we came over here to play pool.
: Okay, yeah. That’ll do it. Osako, Senpai, do you guys want drinks? First round’s on me tonight.
: I’m good for now, thanks.
: I’ll have what she’s having.
: So...nothing?
: No, I’ve just always wanted to say that. I’ll have a beer as it may very well be my last.
: Come, Wakana! Let us rescue our elderly friend from all of the dogs on your cell phone!
: Hah...we’ll be over there when you two are done touching each other.
: Sounds good. Thanks, guys.
: Come to think of it, why are you touching me? You don’t touch boys. You’re allergic to them.
: Yes, that’s what being a lesbian is. Achoo. That aside, are you actually serious about going through with this Dorm Wars thing again?
: Yeah. Why wouldn’t I be?
: Becaaaaaaaause you very recently opened up to me about the fact that you’ve been doing heinous things with a lot of those girls and felt extremely guilty about it?
: Technically, I didn’t say I was trying to stop.
: So you’re just...you’re just gonna keep putting yourself in situations like that then?
: Mhm.
: And you don’t have any problem with that at all?
: No, I have a problem with it.
: Well, why the fuck did you drag me into this then?! Am I not supposed to try and talk you out of this shit?!
: I just wanted to connect with you and I’m not allowed to do that with my penis.
: Ugh. I almost feel like it would be easier if you just did.
: I’m willing to give it a shot if you are, Osako.
: Akira, just don’t do it. I’m off tomorrow. Come hang out with me instead. We can, like...I don’t know...take another weird class or something.
: Whatever we can do to keep you out of a situation where you are very likely going to fuck some high schooler.
: Hell, I’ll hire you a prostitute myself. She just might look and act a lot like Rika and also be named Rika and...probably just be Rika.
: Rika’s not a prostitute.
: I know that. But do you really think she’d say no to screwing you if I offered her like 5,000 yen for it?
: Osako, I can’t just...not go. It’s an annual tradition. Everyone’s expecting me there.
: You literally just didn’t go last time though, right?
: Last time was different. There was a girl at home who needed me to be there for her.
: But this year, she’s going to be there. And I already know that most of her classmates hate her now, so I need to be there too so she doesn’t feel left out.
: Cute story. Question, though. About what percentage of that is the real reason you’re doing this and what percentage is that you just want to fuck another high schooler?
: I’d say it’s an even split.
: Oh my fucking God. I seriously hate caring about you. You make it so fucking difficult.
: None of this would have ever happened if you just liked men. We could have done the penis stuff and been done with it. But no. You had to treat me like a human.
: Yeah. Silly me, right?
: I am thankful though, Osako. That you’re trying to look out for me.
: Are you really, though? You don’t want me to just fuck off and let you destroy yourself?
: I really am, yeah. And if you ever need me for anything, I’ll try to return the favor. I’ll just probably-
: Fail at it because that’s just what you do or something, right?
: You know me so well now.
: You know what would help me, Akira? You not being an irresponsible douchebag. If you want to help me, start there.
: Can’t I just...buy you a new sex toy instead or something?
: This is the worst friendship I have ever had.
: When did those two get so close? Is this another side effect of the foursome I wasn’t invited to?
: They’ve been spending more time together lately. Osako’s been taking Akira with her in her hobby-hunting efforts.
: And you don’t feel weird about that?
: Why would I feel weird? She’s a lesbian and I trust her.
: Besides, the closer she is to Akira, the more rational my relationship with him will likely appear to her.
: They’re good for each other in...a strange way. Neither one really knows who they are. And I see no flaw in letting them figure that out with one another.
: Yeah, I hear you. But, like...what if they fuck?
: Rika, what the hell yo?
: What?! It could happen! Rie thought she was straight until I got ahold of her! What if Akira gets ahold of Osako next?! What if Imani is just the appetizer?!
: Yo! Why doesn’t anyone want to have a normal conversation tonight?!
: That...situation seems so implausible to me that I’m having trouble deciphering how I would react.
: But...it is important to note that the reason Osako and I are taking a minor “break” right now is specifically so she can figure out more about herself.
: I know what I want. I am waiting on her. And if that winds up being more than just...finding herself...so be it.
: Can we not call it a “break?” You guys are still living together and making out and stuff, right? You’re just...fighting.
: It’s not even so much fighting. It’s more that she’s just focusing on herself while I...
: ...sit on the couch and eat ice cream until I want to puke.
: Yup. Been there a trillion times before.
: Wakana...
: It’s...fine. I’m fine.
: Just...stressed is all.
: But I know she’ll come around because she believes in love. And so do I.
: Which is why I so desperately want for her to love herself.
: Hello?
: Would you hug me?
: Nodoka?
: Would you hug me? Yes or no.
: Is there any...context to this? Or...
: Why does everyone always ask about context? There are people who hug each other just for fun, aren’t there?
: I’m...not sure if I’d say they do it for fun specifically.
: So it’s always sexual then?
: No. Sometimes...people want to hug each other for no reason at all. They just like it, I guess.
: Why don’t I ever want that?
: Probably because you don’t like people.
: I like you, though. And Futaba. And Otoha. Do you not like me?
: I like you.
: So you would hug me then?
: Sure. If that makes you happy.
: I’m not sure it does.
: Oh.
: To be frank, it just makes me want to sleep with you. And wrap my legs around your waist as you pump me full of cum.
: Sorry, are we having phone sex right now? Is that what you’re trying to do here?
: There’s something I want to do and I need your help for it.
: So...it is phone sex?
: Last year, I held an event where I rounded up six of the girls from our class and made them compete in a series of sexual contests against one another.
: You did what?
: It was easier than I thought. Apparently, being without you for so long had quite the effect on their respective libidos and willingness to experiment internally.
: Nodoka-
: I’m doing it again this year. And I would like you to be there for it. There’s something I want to see.
: Am I allowed to know who’s coming?
: Does the answer to that question actually influence your decision in some way?
: Uhh...not really, now that I think about. I’m mostly just curious.
: You’ll come then?
: Fuck it. Sure, I’ll come. It’s not like these things are entirely unheard of. I just hope that you won’t use it as an excuse to traumatize anyone.
: I never want to traumatize anyone, Akira. I’m a good girl, not a bad one.
: I don’t know if I fully-
: Yes. Because I don’t want to come if Ami is going to be there.
: Interesting.
: Unfortunately, I cannot satisfy your curiosity at this moment as it runs the risk of exposing the event. So I must know now whether or not you will be attending.
: Well, if you’re going to withhold that information from me, I must respectfully decline. But I thank you for your continued interest in my penis.
: Do you think you can try hugging me some day? In a moment where I would least expect it?
: I’m not sure I’d be able to come up with one where you wouldn’t expect it. You’re pretty consistently operating on another level from what I’ve seen thus far.
: I see.
: Okay. Thank you for your time. I’m going to masturbate now.
: You’re going to what?
: Nodoka?
: Did she really just hang up on me after that?
: What’s Nodoka calling you for at this time of night?
